title: Hotel
content: This dream was last night and I can’t stop thinking about it. Maybe posting will help. I was in my kitchen and needed a mixing bowl. There happened to be a huge hotel next door, similar to the Overlook in the shining. so I went there to try to find a bowl. I walked inside and it was just almost deserted. I got stuck in stairwells and lost my way. I found myself out of the stairwell but lost in the basement and couldn’t get out. It was very damp smelling. I finally found my way outside. But couldn’t get back home. There were people in the back yard. One of them was a very religious woman I work with (irl) and she told me she has an abortion scheduled for the following week. This would never happen anyway, she had a hysterectomy a few years ago. Very strange. Then the sky turned black and there were many stars. They all started to move. Some like shooting stars and some like satellites. Then airplanes started to drop out of the sky. One small plane crashed in the yard. At that point I was so scared I woke myself up. But I can’t get this out of my head.
